newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends firmer, cocoa, sugar mixed.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends firmer, cocoa, sugar mixed.

text.p: COFFEE - Sea-saws, ends mostly firmer within range with origin selling and trade buying. Options active. Jan up $10 at $1,442. COCOA - Retreats after a midsession surge to 931 stg basis March. NY puts pressure. March ends up three at 925 stg. SUGAR - Dec touch firmer in final shakeout before expiry, others slip back in light trade. Dec up $1.00 at $305.50 at 1711 GMT.
